content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Newport News

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which account for your bachelor's degree status and years leading projects—to confirm you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy staff can answer eligibility questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Newport News cohorts deliver the PMI-required contact hours in an interactive format, combining real-world case studies with exam-domain coverage. Attend all sessions and retain your completion certificate—you'll need it for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, register with PMI and submit your formal application, including your training certificate, work history, and required fee. PMI will review your credentials. Once approved, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce PMBOK® knowledge and test-taking strategy. Schedule your exam when ready. The computer-based PMP exam is offered year-round at testing centers near Newport News.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, your PMP is valid for three years. During each three-year cycle, earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) through project work, coursework, volunteer service, or PMI membership. Renew on schedule to keep your credential active and your professional standing current.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
